notes.title: STEAM DECK COMPATABILITY
notes.content:
[h2]The Fox Hare Disaster Chapter One is Steam Deck compatible![/h2]

Take on the creatures of the Fox Hare Shopping Centre anytime and anywhere! The game runs at smooth 60FPS on 1080p and looks great on the Steam Deck! If you're running Docked mode, you may need to change the resolution from 720p to 1080p in the game's options screen - after that you should be good :)

Tell us below what you think of The Fox Hare Disaster and what your scariest encounter has been so far!
